description: Regional and statewide household travel surveys (DOE PNNL repository) is a data set deposited in DOE Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) Repository by its authors Team, TSDC (National Laboratory of the Rockies). The 1993 Baltimore Household Travel Survey is a detailed survey of demographic characteristics and travel patterns for 2,692 households in Baltimore, Maryland. The original goal of the survey was to collect an “ideal” dataset for disaggregate travel demand analysis. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 73 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
